title: Late Charge Schedule for Annual Cycle Invoices: Past-Due Balance and Month's Charge
content:
**1. The invoice charged.** The late charge on a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription billed annually is charged on one invoice: the one carrying the subscription's latest cycle charge by posting date. A subscription carries one cycle charge per cycle start, so no two cycle charges share a posting date.

**2. Past-due balance.** The invoice's past-due balance is the cycle charges and prorated charges on that invoice, less the credits applied to it and less the payments applied to it. Late charges already on the invoice are not part of it.

**3. Month's charge.** The month's late charge is the higher of two figures:

- the plan's monthly late fee percentage of the past-due balance;
- the plan's minimum late fee per invoice per month.

It is charged as a full month. Both figures come from the plan's payment terms.

**4. Rounding.** The late charge is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Building the past-due balance

| Entry on the invoice charged | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Cycle charge | included |
| Prorated (partial-cycle) charges | included |
| Credits applied to the invoice | subtracted |
| Payments applied to the invoice | subtracted |
| Late charges already on the invoice | left out |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures; a hypothetical 2 percent rate and 40.00 USD minimum are used only for illustration)

An annual cycle invoice carries a cycle charge of 3000.00 USD and a prorated charge of 200.00 USD. Applied to it are a credit of 400.00 USD and a payment of 800.00 USD. A late charge of 60.00 USD from an earlier month is also on it.

- Past-due balance: 3000.00 plus 200.00, less 400.00, less 800.00, which is 2000.00. The earlier 60.00 is left out.
- Percentage figure: 2 percent of 2000.00, which is 40.00. This equals the 40.00 minimum, so the month's charge is 40.00.
- Charged as a full month and rounded: 40.00 USD.

On a past-due balance of 1500.00, the percentage figure of 30.00 is below the 40.00 minimum, and the charge is 40.00. On 5000.00 it is 100.00.
